claims: A clean-clone replacement reference that preserves exact OVR-000240 bytes but relocates the historical card path refuses with CC000_CANDIDATE_LEGACY.
Every centralized candidate-admission Git command disables replacement objects and redirects legacy graft lookup to the null device without mutating repository or global configuration.
Normal exact frozen snapshots and ELIGIBLE to INTEGRATED progression continue to pass.
Historical path relocation, root-authority, frozen-continuity, and clean-base controls remain enforced.
Quiet Bell remains content-free, Small Shop contributes process learning only, and execution remains Quiet Bell then Greenhouse then compiler edge cases.
limitations: This verifies local admission against the trusted Git object store, not external attestation or remote-repository identity.
This is not an information-flow proof and does not authenticate objects outside the trusted repository.
This creates no oracle content, candidate, compiler semantic, runtime, fixture, package, release, selection, or public contract.

summary: Verify deterministic local Git object identity for candidate admission.
why: The hardening report and OVR-000252 prove that repository-local object and ancestry overlays cannot redefine the historical policy bytes used by candidate admission while ordinary history remains compatible.
